sections.title: CALS Group A, B, or C

slots.label: Students who are planning to apply to a College of Veterinary Medicine should take BCH 451 (Principles of Biochemistry) and a business course (BUS, ARE, EC, or ACC prefix) to fill the A,B,C elective category. Many Graduate schools also require Biochemistry. Other students: take any courses from the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences Group A, Group B, or Group C electives.
